doc: Wide SettleTransit return branches - expectations shared by the program host dispatcher tests (permutation-frontier/src/wide_land_runtime_tests.rs, native-crypto-tests build) and the keeper planner tests (frontier-node/crates/keeper/tests/wide_reveal.rs). World-independent rules only - each test derives its own literal world and checks these fields against what it observed (dispatcher) or predicted (planner). Not executable-chain evidence. No key material. Values are strings - one field per line.

cases.name: retreated_final_set_roster_entry
cases.source: dispatcher - real Resolve retreat order (plaintext retreat ratio 10000) against a staged hostile resident of 2000000 milli on the arrival tile; keeper - record fixture with the fate

cases.name: boundary_499_destroyed_on_return
cases.source: isolated-handler - the Settled record troops_after staged to 499 after the real SettleDeparture (the muster minimum is 100 troops; a sub-troop value needs an origin clash); outranked bounce

cases.name: boundary_500_roster_entry
cases.source: isolated-handler - the Settled record troops_after staged to 500 (exactly DESTROYED_BELOW); outranked bounce; the home roster paired and free

cases.name: boundary_999_reserve_zero
cases.source: isolated-handler - the Settled record troops_after staged to 999; outranked bounce; the home at the faction cap of 8 so the reserve takes whole units - none

cases.name: boundary_1000_reserve_one
cases.source: isolated-handler - the Settled record troops_after staged to 1000; outranked bounce; the home at the faction cap of 8 so the reserve takes one whole unit

cases.name: routed_boundary_998_to_499_destroyed
cases.source: isolated-handler - the Settled record troops_after staged to 998 after the real SettleDeparture (the muster minimum is 100 troops); the march never revealed, its Citizen absent from the record so wide_valid_outcome is Routed and the dispatcher applies the shared rout_survivors itself - 499; keeper - the same staged record

cases.name: routed_boundary_1000_to_500_reserve_zero
cases.source: isolated-handler - troops_after staged to 1000 after the real SettleDeparture; Routed by the record (Citizen absent from it); rout_survivors 500 - exactly DESTROYED_BELOW - comes home; the home at the faction cap of 8 so the reserve takes zero whole units with a Return record

cases.name: routed_boundary_1998_to_999_reserve_zero
cases.source: isolated-handler - troops_after staged to 1998 after the real SettleDeparture; Routed by the record; rout_survivors 999 comes home; the home at the faction cap of 8 so the reserve takes zero whole units with a Return record

cases.name: routed_boundary_2000_to_1000_reserve_one
cases.source: isolated-handler - troops_after staged to 2000 after the real SettleDeparture; Routed by the record; rout_survivors 1000 comes home; the home at the faction cap of 8 so the reserve takes one whole unit

cases.name: home_is_destination_unresolved_rout
cases.source: dispatcher - a staged departure (as every departure of these tests) whose valid seal names the home province with a zero-step path, never revealed, the home resolved past the arrival with no record; keeper - InputsUnresolved (not planned - the resolver position would be unlisted)
cases.comparison: coverage gap - the dispatcher settles this unresolved form and the planner refuses it by design; the two sides do not agree on an outcome here and none is claimed; the resolved form at the home has keeper evidence only (see home_is_destination_resolved_headroom)

cases.name: home_is_destination_resolved_retreated
cases.source: dispatcher - real Reveal at the home (a one-step path to a neighbouring tile of the home province - walk_wide refuses an empty path), real Gather and Resolve there with the kernel retreat order (plaintext ratio 10000) against a staged hostile resident of 2000000 milli on the committed tile, then SettleTransit with one province account in the destination and home positions; keeper - record fixture with the fate at the home
cases.comparison: matching settlement semantics only - Reveal plaintext and complete account worlds differ

cases.name: home_is_destination_resolved_headroom
cases.source: keeper only - a staged resolved record at the home province with a Bounced fate; the one province account must take two records
cases.comparison: coverage gap closed on the dispatcher side by home_is_destination_resolved_retreated; this entry keeps the planner headroom pin over a Bounced fixture
